question: For Total Dissolved Solids, Net 30-day average limits at Outfall 001, which footnote-governed limit set applies when evaluating a monitoring period in Federal FY2025 that intersects the transition between the footnote *10 period (limits lasting through three years from the permit effective date) and the footnote *11 period (limits beginning three years from the permit effective date)?
semantic_arguments: Footnote *10: 27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L (30-day average); 'lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date'
Footnote *11: 24,992 lbs/day and 449 mg/L (30-day average); 'beginning 3 year from the permit effective date'
Limit type is 30-day average, so rolling or calendar monitoring periods may span the three-year boundary within FY2025
notes: Footnotes *10 and *11 assign different numeric limits to the same parameter and use overlapping boundary language at the three-year mark. Resolving how that transition applies to 30-day average monitoring periods would change which enforceable limit is used for compliance comparison during portions of FY2025.
